content.heading: Finance Commission
content.text: The President shall, within two years from the commencement of this Constitution and thereafter at the expiration of every fifth year or at such earlier time as the President considers necessary, by order constitute a Finance Commission which shall consist of a Chairman and four other members to be appointed by the President. It shall be the duty of the Commission to make recommendations on the distribution of tax proceeds between the Union and the States and the principles of grants-in-aid as enacted.
